layer_organic_max_tail_consensus.orientation: final-layer residual target NLL anchor only
layer_organic_max_tail_consensus.within_layer_features: module-mean max-token target NLL; module-mean max-token top-1 surprisal; module-mean max-token entropy excess over top-1 surprisal

lens96_hierarchical_dufs.solver: DUFS-LIU-PCR within groups and across virtual experts
lens96_hierarchical_dufs.source: four token-mean lens metrics x three module positions x spaced eight layers

max_entropy_excess_over_top1_top8.depth_rule: not forced; selected layers are reported
max_entropy_excess_over_top1_top8.formula: max_t[H(module, layer, token) + log p_top1(module, layer, token)]

max_target_gap_spread4.aggregation: one anchor-reliable module/layer view from every depth quartile

max_target_nll_organic_all.aggregation: equal module mean inside every layer, then all-layer anchor-reliability consensus

max_target_nll_spread8.aggregation: two anchor-reliable views per depth quartile; |Spearman| weights
max_target_nll_spread8.depth_rule: four equal contiguous bands; two views per band

max_top1_surprisal_spread8.aggregation: two anchor-reliable views per depth quartile; |Spearman| weights
max_top1_surprisal_spread8.depth_rule: four equal contiguous bands; two views per band

mean_entropy_excess_top1_organic_top8.aggregation: equal module mean inside layers, then eight anchor-reliable layer experts

mean_kl_to_final_spread8.aggregation: two anchor-reliable module/layer views per depth quartile
mean_kl_to_final_spread8.depth_rule: four equal contiguous bands; eight total views

selection_history: Pure inner-state candidate selected retrospectively after the final hybrid and the strengthened atomic-view oracle exposed a 0.00015 AUROC gap. A compact label-free depth-summary screen selected mean KL-to-final with two views forced from each depth quartile. No cell is independent confirmation.
success_target: macro AUROC above both the best-single-layer oracle and TriLens grouped L2 probe
